name: build-distribution-readiness
job: Turn an exact product artifact into one audience-selected, channel-specific, support-ready Distribution Evidence Pack.

inScope: Selecting the smallest complete channel set from real user journeys
Requiring and verifying one immutable target-artifact set per selected channel
Modeling channel state machines with durable receipts and consumer-side readback
Binding release communication variants to the exact shipped identity
outOfScope: Provider or channel mutation authority (active product repository and delivery profile)

inputs: Owner-approved immutable product and release target
Exact source revision, version, target artifacts and digests
Audience, invocation journeys, territories, and selected channels
outputs: Distribution Evidence Pack with channel capability and evidence matrix
Exact per-channel blockers, next machine actions, and required live readback
Release communication variants bound to shipped identity

tools: official channel/package-manager tooling for selected channels
data: current official requirements per channel, territory, and action
permissions: publish credentials owned by the active delivery profile

failureSemantics: An untested channel row is unknown, never inherited from another OS or runtime; blockers are typed by exact dependency, failed proof, external authority pending, or policy floor, and no release is called complete without live readback evidence.

outcome.observable: A Distribution Evidence Pack where every selected channel names its exact artifact identity, install/upgrade behavior, and live readback proof, and every blocker names its next machine action.
